title: Channel Cosmic
description: A man dressed as a cosmic magician stands centered inside an old CRT television frame, holding a glowing eye symbol in one hand while surrounded by swirling galaxies, planets, nebulae, and ethereal creatures against a black space background. The television screen is bordered by a ring of bright white lights, with text at the bottom reading 'LOGAN - 1000 PAINTINGS CHALLENGE - CHANNEL COSMIC'.
prompt: A dramatic surreal scene of a handsome magician with dark hair wearing an ornate black and purple coat with glowing white symbols, standing inside an old CRT television. He holds a large floating eye symbol emitting orange energy in one hand. The background is deep space filled with swirling galaxies, colorful nebulae, planets, and ghostly ethereal creatures. The TV screen has a bright border of white lights. Text at bottom reads 'LOGAN - 1000 PAINTINGS CHALLENGE - CHANNEL COSMIC'. Mystical and cosmic atmosphere.
